messages:
maria (docs): Quick sync — I opened a migration PR for the new tiered metering docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4820. Main asks: update SDK header examples, add a short cost calc example, rename dashboard panel screenshots to match new metric names, and fix a couple of broken links. Ping @raj for pricing numbers and @leah for snippet validation.

raj (billing): Sounds good. Confirming the pro tier rate is 0.0008 per token and burst credits apply hourly. We also track a per-minute token bucket for rate limiting — call it "minute_bucket" in the schema.

ben (product): Heads-up — we renamed the dashboard metric label from "Active tokens" -> "Effective tokens" last week. That will make current screenshots look out-of-date. I can regenerate the panel PNGs after snippets are sorted.

leah (eng): For SDK examples, prefer showing the new header `X-RW-Usage` and response header `X-RW-Quota-Remaining`. Quick curl draft (use single quotes to avoid escaping):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'X-RW-Usage: {"tokens":120,"tier":"pro"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
I'll convert that to py/js SDK snippets. Note: async example in current docs misses an `await` in the JS snippet.

maria (docs): OK I'll swap the curl to single-quote form and add both py/js SDK examples. Proposed docs copy: "Monthly cost = total_tokens * price_per_token + burst adjustments (see billing table)" — should we include a worked example?

raj (billing): Please include a worked example. Example: 10M tokens * 0.0008 = $8,000. Add note: if burst credits reduce billable tokens by 2% that month, show adjusted example too.

ben (product): Add a short caption explaining why "Effective tokens" differs from raw tokens (it includes system prompts, cached prefixes, and reranked tokens). That will cut down support confusion.

maria (docs): Good point — I'll add a short explainer box under the screenshot. Also updating the dashboard step-by-step: panel name, query, and brief note about why we changed label.

leah (eng): One more: the SDK header example should include a small JSON snippet for the metering schema we accept. Proposed inline example (single line): `{"tokens":120,"tier":"pro","request_id":"req_abc123"}`. I'll paste full SDK samples in a follow-up commit.

docs-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy.redwood.ai/pr-4820-preview — expires in 7 days.

maria (docs): Thanks — I'll push commit now with updated snippets + placeholders for images. Request reviewers: @leah for code, @raj for pricing wording, @ben for UX copy.

leah (eng): Reviewing now. Found one nit: JS async example missing `await client.generate(...)` — will comment on the PR.

raj (billing): Also add a short note in the migration guide: "If you relied on the old burst credit policy, verify your billing dashboard for the first two billing cycles." Helps customers avoid surprises.

ben (product): One last nit: change the FAQ line from "quota reset daily" to "quota reset hourly" where appropriate in tier docs. I'll mark exact lines in the PR.

maria (docs): Good catch. I'll address both and ping again once I push the fixes. Appreciated. :thumbsup: 

leah (eng): Left inline comments on PR about the await and the example header JSON formatting. Will approve after small fix.

raj (billing): LGTM on pricing copy update. Approve once docs show the worked example numbers.

maria (docs): Pushed updates (commit c3f9a2). Added a short cost calc example, replaced screenshots placeholders, and fixed three links that were previously 404ing. Deploy preview updated.

docs-bot: Preview updated: https://deploy.redwood.ai/pr-4820-preview (new).

ben (product): Reviewing preview — looks good except the panel image still has old label. I'll upload regenerated PNG in a follow-up commit.

maria (docs): OK will wait for that then merge. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
